newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV sells Russian E&P unit to Eurogas.
newsitem.headline: OMV sells Russian E&P unit to Eurogas.

text.p: Austrian oil group OMV said on Thursday it had sold its Russian OMV Jakutien exploration unit to Eurogas Inc of the United States for 72 million schillings effective June 11.
In a statement, OMV said the move was part of its strategy of concentrating production activities on projects that promised early returns.
"Accordingly, OMV has decided to withdraw from this long-term project," the firm said.
OMV Jakutien, based in Yakutia in Russia's far east, has a 50 percent stake in the TAKT oil and gas exploration venture. The remaining 50 percent is held by state firm Sakhaneftegaz.
OMV said TAKT had found evidence of significant reserves of gas, suitable for export to South Korea, China or Japan. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
